title: Mochizuki Honami — Test Of Courage 2?!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Sewing Lounge

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I've finished putting in the basting stitches for this costume, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I really appreciate you doing that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I've also reached a nice point to stop, so why don't we take a quick break here?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, sounds good!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Still, you looked like a total pro while working with the sewing machine just now! Do you use them a lot?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I've enjoyed making handicrafts since I was little, but I also use sewing machines quite a lot to adjust the sizes on Shibao's clothes...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Shibao?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right..
I have a pet dog named Shibao, but it's so difficult to find clothes in his size...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It feels like such a shame whenever I find something cute for him to wear that doesn't fit. Which is why I've taken it upon myself to alter them myself.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, okay!
That definitely explains why you know your way around a sewing machine!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I appreciate the compliment.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
But you're very good as well, Mizuki.
You work so smoothly and without hesitation...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You think so?
I do sorta make alterations to clothes on a regular basis.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'll find cute clothes whenever I go shopping, but they're always missing that little something that I think would make them perfect!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, I'll add a bit of lace, give it some gather and stuff... And alter it just the way I like!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see... That's so impressive.
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you both for being so patient.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hi, Shizuku! What's up?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I hope work went well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry for being late.
What were you two working on just now...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We actually just reached a nice point where we could take a break. We've just about finished putting in the basting stitches for everything.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're going to make some alterations to something you already have, yes?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes! It's...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This! I'm going to use it to become a yuki-onna!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wow, what a beautiful haori! It's pure white...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! Imagine Shizuku appearing in front of you while wearing this! She'd definitely make my heart stop...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, your heart? We wouldn't want that...
I need to be careful not to scare everyone I encounter on the day of.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, it is sorta your job as a scarer to jump out at people...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: In any case, this haori should be perfect for our test of courage.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I actually bought this during our school trip to Kyoto. I immediately fell in love with it after seeing it on display in one of the shops...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I even got to be a part of the Hyakki Yako Parade as a yuki-onna!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Using this handheld fan that makes it snow!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Wow, that's incredible...
It's like you're putting on a little show for us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I actually borrowed this from Kamishiro. I asked Tsukasa to ask him after I decided to help with your test of courage.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's strange how running into him during that school trip is coming back around to help me like this.

rows.Speaker: Honami & Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I didn't realize you both knew him...
We really do live in a small world.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Still, Kamishiro did such a wonderful job with this device. He never ceases to amaze me...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, it is pretty amazing...
But this is surprisingly subdued considering it's something Rui made.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, we're talking about someone who likes to make things that create lightning or trick floors that launch people up and other crazy stuff.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: He can make those kinds of devices?! That's remarkable...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, he must be quite the engineer...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I've seen a few of their shows that involved armies of robots and drones. Kamishiro is responsible for making all of them, isn't he?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The way they all moved was so cute that I couldn't help but smile.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, those are also on the less crazy side!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But that reminds me of this one device that made me totally crack up!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, what kind of device was it?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You're never gonna guess...
It was this thing that would play recordings of Tsukasa's voice whenever you pressed the button.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? Tsukasa's voice...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. They were recordings of things he'd said, but they were all really hilarious.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: For example, his trademark “Hah hah hah!” laugh... And the way he shouts, “Whaaat?!” whenever he's surprised!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And that happens every time you press the button. I think I did a year's worth of laughing that time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. A button that makes you laugh each time you press it. That's so wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, it is.
Can you tell us what other recordings there were?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Umm... There was also his line about Tenma being written as “soaring pegasus”! And...
